instruction: Export Thunderbird Personal Address Book to contacts.csv on Desktop, convert to XLSX with LibreOffice Calc, and ensure the XLSX has 37 columns matching the Thunderbird export format.

metadata.explanation: Task requires XLSX to have 37 columns matching Thunderbird export format. Verified from contacts_gold.xlsx: max_column=37.

Insufficient coverage: Verifies only 1 of 3 instruction requirements (CSV export, conversion, column format matching)
